metadata.title: Expanded Programme for Government commitment register
metadata.method: Thematic extraction of monitorable commitments across 11 major policy domains. Summaries are paraphrased and retain printed page references.
limitations: This is not a literal transcription of every action in the 162-page programme.
Annual milestones, baselines and single accountable owners are often absent from the source and must be verified.
No delivery status is assigned in this extraction.
